LoyaltyCard.title: LoyaltyCard
LoyaltyCard.description: Tracks a Google-authenticated customer's Broaster purchases (10 Broasters = 1 in-store surprise gift).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the card owner.

displayName.description: Customer display name shown on the loyalty card.

stamps.description: Current stamps on the active 10-slot card (0 to 9).

availableRewards.description: Number of unlocked surprise gifts ready to redeem in-store.

redeemedRewards.description: Total number of surprise gifts already redeemed in-store.

activeRewardCode.description: Verification code for an active surprise gift, or NONE when 0 rewards are available.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the loyalty card was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the loyalty card was last updated.

/loyaltyCards/{userId}.description: Per-user loyalty card document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
